notes: Delete mirroring finance-replace-0014: removes 'Siemens is a constituent of the DAX', the revision's original fact, a stored fact on a functional relation (benchmark_constituent_of, in staging/finance-replace-abox.RELATIONS.md: the one national benchmark index a company belongs to; Siemens is also in the Euro Stoxx 50, which is not a national benchmark and is not touched). Cardinality question: another candidate index, the FTSE 100 (the revision's new value), 'no' before because a company belongs to one national benchmark index; after the removal the reason for 'no' is gone, so 'does not know'. Related near uses subproperty (plain index membership); related far reaches the subject by its legal name Siemens AG (binding, the alias checked before editing). The revision's far question (which country's index) was dropped because 'Germany' follows from Siemens being a German company, so it can be answered without the DAX. Derived: two compositions through the removed fact that look up a fact stored about the DAX by name, the exchange its companies trade on (Frankfurt) and what its name stands for (Deutscher Aktienindex); neither is guessable from Siemens alone. The revision's FTSE 350, London listing, fund and primary-listing questions describe the new index and do not apply to a removal. Counts for the revision's own phrases are copied from finance-replace-0014; new phrases are in count_requests.
